onchain_spotcheck.selection_bias: I deliberately sampled the nonce-0 members; the investigator's 30-sample (23 human-like) was mostly aged members. Both are consistent: the six clusters are ~46% aged wallets (nonce>=20) and ~36% fresh, vs 59%/22% in the h32-36 0.05 population and 94-100% fresh in the audited farms.

corrections_to_investigator: 'Reasons on 21 of the 27 clusters' -> 17 of 27 (their own per-cluster list).
'40 blocks with >=5 0.05 joins' -> 34 in the rule's universe (single-deposit wallets); 40 only when multi-deposit wallets are counted.

'Burst members real 202 vs null 157.5' is a +3.4 sigma EXCESS under their null, which contradicts 'vacuous' on its face; the excess disappears under a within-10-minute (188+/-11) or within-25-block (192+/-11) null - that is the number that supports the claim.

affected_wallets_estimate 50 counts only the six no-funding clusters; the wallets whose flag is load-bearing on late 0.05 cadence edges are 131 (0.114% of points). Of these, c247 (9) + c241 (11) hold the verified 0x3230466e recycling farm (13 farm-funded), c260 holds 3 provable sybil-mechanics wallets, c210/c215/c220 hold chain links. Plausibly-honest release is ~100, not 50 and not 131.

Suggested fix part 1 (>=2 qualifying blocks within the same wave window) is ineffective: 34 of the 47 qualifying blocks are inside h33-35 (22 in h34 alone). Only the protocol-minimum exemption changes the outcome.
Suggested drip fix ('only when the amount's share of the hour's joins < 30%') releases the 0x3230466e recycler (h33 0.05 share 78%) - the one thing drip actually caught.
Their 'fresh_hub_complement' list is partly wrong: 0xcb0bb35c (x3) is a zero-value dust spammer, 0x2cff890f (x3) is a 2,700-ETH exchange/whale wallet that bankrolled the h35 rescuer, not a farm hub.

Their 'human-like' heuristic (aged, many txs, many targets) is defeated by the traced chain: 0x5b2dda1f (nonce 252) and 0xd9e6867712 (Jan-2026 history) are links of the same 0.0616-ETH peel chain as six fresh wallets. 'Aged' in this rally includes operators' own reused wallets.

Severity 'high' is arguable: 0.11% of points and ~100 honest wallets out of 11,573 flagged; the bigger defect exposed here is the OPPOSITE one - peel chains across components (funder = earlier contributor, forward-the-remainder within minutes) are invisible to sybilkit because funding:peel_chain requires the funder to sit in the same tier-A component.
strongest_supported_claim: In the h32-36 rally the cadence family on the 0.05 minimum has no discriminative power: the burst guard (>=2 qualifying blocks, game-wide, 47 blocks / 34 inside the rally) is a tautology at this density, burst membership is within ~1 sigma of a within-10-minute organic null, and drip fires 2-3 sigma BELOW organic expectation. 131 flagged wallets (0.114% of points, 45 nonce-0, 7 ENS) hang on those edges; 6 clusters / 50 wallets have no other family than the equally-vacuous sequence rule. Exempting the minimum from cadence after h24 releases ~100 plausibly honest wallets but also ~25-30 real sybil wallets (0x3230466e recycler, 0x5b2dda1f chain links, c260 mini-farm children) that only a cross-component peel-chain rule would re-catch.
